in_hebrew.name: יְגנֶס
in_hebrew.meaning: יגנס - to be strong, to prevail
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root גנס (gns) - to be strong, to prevail. The name Jenness may be derived from this root, although it is not found in the Bible.

in_greek.name: Jenness
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Jenny + grace
in_greek.long_meaning: Jenness είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. The name Jenness is derived from the Old English name Jenny, which means 'Lord's favored one' or 'Jenny + grace'. It may also have Greek or Latin origins, with 'Ienna' meaning 'white wave' or 'Ienna' meaning 'Juno's gracious gift'.
